theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 8 群

items.colloc: meet the CEO 會見執行長 | report to the CEO 向執行長報告
items.distinct: president 總裁 | general manager 總經理
ex: The chief executive officer will host the meeting.
執行長將親自主持這次會議。
Our chief executive officer is visiting the new plant.
我們的執行長正在參訪新工廠。
The chief executive officer decided to expand the business.
執行長決定擴大業務規模。

items.colloc: clear the table top 清理桌面 | a polished table top 光滑的桌面
items.distinct: desktop 電腦桌面 | countertop 櫃檯桌面
ex: Please clear your documents from the table top.
請將文件從桌面上移開。
The table top is made of solid oak wood.
這張桌子的桌面是用實心橡木做的。
We placed the projector on the table top.
我們把投影機放在桌面上。

items.colloc: a sharp curve 急轉彎 | ahead of the curve 領先趨勢
items.distinct: line 直線 | angle 角度
ex: Sales figures showed a curve of steady growth.
銷售數據呈現出穩定成長的曲線。
The road has a sharp curve near the factory.
工廠附近的道路有一個大轉彎。
Our company stays ahead of the curve in technology.
我們公司在技術發展上保持領先。

items.colloc: a wide range of 廣泛的 | price range 價格區間
items.distinct: scope 領域範疇 | variety 各式各樣
ex: We offer a wide range of logistics services.
我們提供廣泛的物流服務。
The items fall within a reasonable price range.
這些商品的價格落在合理的區間內。
The product is available in a range of colors.
該產品有各種顏色可供選擇。

items.colloc: change a tire 更換輪胎 | flat tire 爆胎
items.distinct: wheel 車輪 | rubber 橡膠
ex: The delivery truck had a flat tire today.
送貨卡車今天發生了爆胎。
We need to check the tire pressure regularly.
我們需要定期檢查輪胎胎壓。
The mechanic replaced a tire on the company car.
維修技師更換了公務車的一個輪胎。

items.colloc: put off a meeting 推遲會議 | put off the decision 延後決定
items.distinct: postpone 推遲（正式用語）| delay 延遲（指時間上的拖延）
ex: We decided to put off the launch date.
我們決定推遲發表日期。
Don't put off responding to the client's email.
不要推遲回覆客戶的電子郵件。
The board meeting was put off until Friday.
董事會會議被推遲到週五。

items.pos: phr. 透過清償未結債務
items.colloc: clear the debt 清償債務 | outstanding balance 未結餘額
items.distinct: pay off 償還 | settle 結算
ex: The firm improved by clearing its outstanding debt.
公司透過清償未結債務改善了財務狀況。
They succeeded by clearing its outstanding debt quickly.
他們藉由迅速清償未結債務而成功。
Focus on by clearing its outstanding debt first.
首要任務應是透過清償未結債務來穩定公司。

items.colloc: label a file folder 標記資料夾 | thick file folder 厚的資料夾
items.distinct: binder 活頁夾 | envelope 信封
ex: Please put these contracts in a file folder.
請將這些合約放入檔案夾中。
I cannot find the blue file folder anywhere.
我到處都找不到那個藍色的檔案夾。
Organize your papers in a separate file folder.
請將文件分類整理到不同的檔案夾。

items.colloc: heavy traffic 交通擁擠 | stuck in traffic 困在車陣中
items.distinct: traffic jam 交通堵塞 | congestion 壅塞
ex: I will be late because we have traffic.
因為遇到塞車我會遲到。
The highway tends to have traffic every morning.
這條高速公路每天早上往往都有車流。
We have traffic, so please start the meeting.
現在遇到塞車了，請先開始會議吧。

items.colloc: in fact, it is 事實上是 | in fact, no 事實上沒有
items.distinct: actually 實際上 | as a matter of fact 事實上
ex: In fact, the project was finished ahead of time.
事實上，該專案提前完成了。
The report is not ready; in fact, it is missing.
報告還沒準備好，事實上，它不見了。
In fact, we have already hired a new manager.
事實上，我們已經聘請了一位新經理。

items.pos: phr. 大體上；很大程度上
items.colloc: in large part 在很大程度上 | in large measure 在很大程度上
items.distinct: by and large 大體上 | in general 一般來說
ex: The success is in large part due to your help.
這次成功在很大程度上歸功於您的幫助。
This policy is in large measure a total failure.
這項政策在很大程度上是徹底的失敗。
In large part, the staff likes the new rules.
整體而言，員工們喜歡新的規則。

items.colloc: attend a job fair 參加就業博覽會 | host a job fair 舉辦徵才展
items.distinct: career fair 職涯博覽會 | recruitment event 招募活動
ex: Our company will attend a job fair tomorrow.
我們公司明天將參加就業博覽會。
Bring your resume to the annual job fair.
帶著你的履歷去參加年度就業博覽會。
Many students visited the job fair for opportunities.
許多學生參觀了就業博覽會尋找機會。

items.colloc: accept a job offer 接受工作邀約 | receive a job offer 收到錄取通知
items.distinct: job application 求職申請 | employment contract 聘僱合約
ex: I am happy to accept your job offer today.
我很高興今天接受您的工作錄取通知。
She received a job offer from a global firm.
她收到了一家跨國企業的工作錄取通知。
The job offer includes health insurance and bonuses.
這份工作邀約包含醫療保險與獎金。

items.colloc: in accordance with rules 依照規則 | in accordance with regulations 根據規定
items.distinct: according to 根據 | in line with 符合
ex: The work was completed in accordance with the contract terms.
工作是按照合約條款完成的。
We handle all requests in accordance with company policy.
我們皆依照公司政策處理所有請求。
Please fill out the form in accordance with these instructions.
請依照這些說明填寫表格。

items.pos: phr. 管理層關注安全性
items.zh: 管理階層擔心安全問題
items.colloc: be concerned about 對...感到擔憂 | top management 高階管理層
items.distinct: management is worried 擔心 | management cares about 重視
ex: Management is concerned about security at the site.
管理階層對於該場地的安全性感到擔憂。
Clearly, management is concerned about security of data.
顯然地，管理階層很關心資料的安全性。
Because management is concerned about security, we updated locks.
由於管理階層擔心安全，我們更新了門鎖。

items.colloc: experience from a previous job 前職經驗 | leave a previous job 離職
items.distinct: former job 前任工作 | current job 目前工作
ex: My previous job involved a lot of traveling.
我的前一份工作需要頻繁出差。
List your previous job on the resume clearly.
請在履歷上清楚列出你的前一份工作。
I learned many sales skills in my previous job.
我在前一份工作中學到了許多銷售技巧。

items.colloc: import raw materials 進口原料 | cost of raw materials 原料成本
items.distinct: finished product 成品 | commodity 商品
ex: The factory has a shortage of raw material.
工廠目前有原料短缺的問題。
High prices of raw material affect our profits.
原物料的高價格影響了我們的利潤。
We need to source quality raw material today.
我們今天需要採購高品質的原材料。

items.colloc: meet the sales target 達到銷售目標 | exceed the sales target 超過銷售目標
items.distinct: sales quota 銷售配額 | sales forecast 銷售預測
ex: The team reached its quarterly sales target early.
團隊提前達成了季度銷售目標。
We need to adjust our annual sales target.
我們需要調整年度銷售目標。
Setting a realistic sales target is crucial.
制定切合實際的銷售目標至關重要。

items.colloc: send in an application 提交申請 | send in a resume 寄出履歷
items.distinct: submit 提交 | hand in 遞交
ex: Please send in your proposal by next Friday.
請在下週五前提交您的提案。
I decided to send in my application today.
我決定今天將我的申請表寄出。
Did you send in the tax documents yet?
你已經把稅務文件送交了嗎？

items.zh: 創業很花錢；創業代價高
items.colloc: start a business 創業 | high cost 高成本
items.distinct: expensive 昂貴的 | investment 投資
ex: Many people agree that starting a business is costly.
許多人都認同創業的成本很高。
Realize that starting a business is costly before acting.
在行動前要認知到創業是非常花錢的。
Because starting a business is costly, prepare funds.
由於創業費用高昂，請務必準備好資金。
